_readme: Optional cloud models for HomeAI (OpenRouter). Copy to data\cloud.json, put your OpenRouter API key alone in data\openrouter.key (or set OPENROUTER_API_KEY), then press Rescan in the model picker. Only requests for these cloud/... ids leave the PC; Auto routing never picks them. Set a model's "enabled" to true/false to show or hide it (no restart needed). "vision": true allows image attachments, "ctx" is shown in the picker, "params" are default request fields.
